description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter for displaying a horizontally scrolling carousel of video items on an Android TV interface. It manages view creation, data binding, and focus UI cues for each video card.

classes.name: VideoCarouselAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying a list of VideoItem objects in a RecyclerView as a horizontal carousel specific to TV devices.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and inflates the item view for each video in the carousel.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds video data to the view holder and sets focus change listener for UI cue effects.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of video items.

inner_classes.name: VideoViewHolder
inner_classes.description: Holds references to views within each video item layout (thumbnail and title).

methods.name: VideoCarouselAdapter
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the adapter with context and list of videos.
